# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas practice: free beginner-friendly AI education for the Dallas–Fort Worth community, plus paid services for local small businesses — missed-call text-back automation ($49/month), small-business websites ($500 build + $49/month hosting), and AI workflow automation. Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, +1 (469) 425-4142. Service area: Dallas, Richardson, Plano, Garland, Allen (Texas, USA).

Key facts:
- Founder: Jack Qian, Business Planner at Texas Instruments and Dallas AI educator. Has run a 70-person multi-agent AI workshop (May 2026) and a 37-person AI hackathon (April 2026) in the Dallas area.
- Missed-Call Rescue: when a business misses a call, the caller gets an automatic text with a booking link within ten seconds. $49/month flat, free install, keep your existing number, 30-day money-back.
- Websites: booking-first sites for salons, barbershops, clinics, and other Dallas local businesses. $500 flat build, live within a week, $49/month hosting, Google Business Profile included.
- AI education: free community classes, hands-on workshops, and build events for working professionals. No coding required.

## Services

- [Missed Call Text Back](https://aimanjack.com/missed-call-text-back/): flagship service — every missed call texts the customer back in ten seconds; $49/month, free install, 30-day money-back
- [Small Business Website Design](https://aimanjack.com/website/): $500 build, $49/month, live in a week, for Dallas local businesses
- [Salon Website Design](https://aimanjack.com/website/salons/): booking-first websites for hair salons, nail salons, and beauty pros
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://aimanjack.com/ai-workflow/): missed-call textback, review support, and lead follow-up using the tools a business already has
- [AI Consulting & Automation Services](https://aimanjack.com/business-services/): start with one bottleneck, build only what helps
